svg.title: The 20 most valuable technology firms grouped by home, November 17, 2026
svg.desc: A wall of company logos grouped by home. United States, 14: Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon, SpaceX, Broadcom, Meta, Tesla, AMD, Micron, Palantir, Cisco, Oracle. South Korea, 2: Samsung, SK Hynix. China, 2: Tencent, CXMT. Taiwan, 1: TSMC. European Union, 1, highlighted: ASML. The European Union's next firms, at ranks 21 to 50: SAP, Schneider Electric, and Spotify.
